findings.desc: docs/requirements/decisions/dynamic-finding-system-execution-plan.md:938-943,1012-1018,1189-1191 — defer-with-proof gate contradiction: Path C promises that every known or uncertain protected-surface risk must complete Red -> root cause -> fix -> Green in the current Story regardless of assigned severity, but the only authoritative predicate first requires policy.effectiveBlockingSeverities.includes(finding.severity) and its inputs contain no protected-surface state. A low/medium protected-surface Finding excluded by the current severity policy therefore returns non-blocking before applicabilityAndDispositionBlocks runs; protectedSurfaceImpact exists only inside a deferral record, which an ineligible Path-C Finding will not have. The Story tests repeat the promise without specifying a gate-consumed protected-risk fact or severity-elevation rule. Define a signed protected-surface classification available for every applicable Finding and make the shared predicate enforce it independently of ordinary severity/round decay (or narrow the prose to mere deferral ineligibility); otherwise the advertised mandatory Red-to-Green safety floor is not mechanically expressible.

docs/requirements/decisions/dynamic-finding-system-execution-plan.md:549,678-704,795-835,904-925,976-1010 — signed route acceptance is a mandatory safety input but no RouteReceipt contract exists. CandidateRoute and FindingDeferralDisposition carry only routeReceiptId; FindingLedgerReceipt proves persistence and explicitly does not attest content truth, while no modeled record binds the candidate/finding/deferral, target Story or B-META gap, owner identity/authority, acceptance decision, freshness, signature, and revocation/closure state. append_route_receipt and atomic-commit prose therefore cannot establish the repeated claim that the existing target/owner accepted the route, and the gate/scorecard cannot validate owner acceptance without inventing semantics in implementation. Add an explicit signed RouteReceipt schema plus writer authority, validation/freshness/revocation rules, references from the manifest and ledger receipt, and Story 2/3 ownership/tests; otherwise defer-with-proof can degrade into an unowned waiver despite the stated policy.

docs/requirements/decisions/dynamic-finding-system-execution-plan.md:548-580,678-704,816-820,1004-1010 [high] route-authority gap: defer-with-proof can clear an otherwise-blocking verified Finding only when a signed routeReceiptId proves the target/owner accepted the route, but the plan defines no RouteReceipt record, signer/eligible accepting authority, target-state/hash binding, or verifier contract. Finding Ledger Integrity explicitly proves persistence only and disclaims routing judgment; Candidate and Defect Identity owns advisory routing only; Dynamic Applicability only defines assessment/deferral authority. A bare ID therefore cannot mechanically prove owner acceptance and leaves a circular/unowned L4 dependency that an implementation could fabricate or validate inconsistently. Define the receipt schema and authority boundary, assign its semantic writer/verifier to Story 1 or Story 2 while Story 3 owns only atomic persistence, and add tamper/wrong-target/wrong-owner/stale-target negative tests before allowing deferral to affect the gate.

docs/requirements/decisions/dynamic-finding-system-execution-plan.md:938-964,1012-1018,1189-1191 — the promised mandatory repair for every verified applicable high Finding conflicts with the explicitly preserved round-decay predicate. isDynamicFindingBlocking still applies !isAdvisoryThisRound before the disposition decision, and the current advisory contract makes high advisory from Round 3 onward; section 7.1 also says current round-decay semantics continue. Consequently an unfixed high Finding can clear the blocker through round decay without any deferral, Red/root-cause/fix/Green, contradicting Path C and Story 1 acceptance. Critical does not decay, but high does. Either define and register a non-decaying mandatory-repair class/fact for applicable high and protected-surface Findings, or narrow the Red-to-Green promise to critical/currently blocking severities and state that high still follows existing decay. The present plan cannot simultaneously preserve decay and guarantee high repair.

docs/requirements/decisions/dynamic-finding-system-execution-plan.md:938-943,1012-1018 [high] The shared predicate applies effectiveBlockingSeverities and round decay before applicability/deferral, so a high Finding becomes advisory in Round 3 and a low/medium protected-surface Finding can remain non-blocking even though Path C says every high/critical or protected-surface risk must be fixed with fresh Green before the blocker clears. Refusing deferral cannot enforce mandatory repair when the old predicate has already returned false. Specify one mechanically enforceable rule: either preserve existing decay and narrow the Path C claim to only prevent defer_with_proof, or add a registered protected/high hard-floor predicate with tests showing all consumers agree and rollback restores the prior rule.

docs/requirements/decisions/dynamic-finding-system-execution-plan.md:678-704,793-836,902-922 [high] CandidateRoute and FindingDeferralDisposition require a signed routeReceiptId proving target/owner acceptance, but the data model defines no RouteReceipt contract, signer, authority, target/owner binding, acceptance status, or freshness validation. FindingLedgerReceipt only records an append_route_receipt operation, has no signature, and proves persistence rather than target acceptance. This leaves the gate-critical anti-waiver proof uninterpretable and the three-Story ownership incomplete. Define the signed accepted-route receipt schema and assign its acceptance writer/verifier to Story 2 or Story 1 while Story 3 owns only atomic persistence; test wrong target, wrong owner, stale/closed target, forged signer, and atomic rollback.

docs/requirements/decisions/dynamic-finding-system-execution-plan.md:707-721,793-823,988-1008 [medium] Deferral says root-cause analysis may remain for the target Story, yet every deferral requires canonicalDefectId and the only CanonicalDefect contract requires a concrete rootCause string. A new reproduced defect with unknown root cause cannot satisfy both contracts without fabricating a placeholder or doing the work deferral is meant to postpone. Make the dependency implementable by allowing an explicitly unresolved canonical identity state/rootCause, or require deferral to reference an already-confirmed canonical defect whose root cause is known and state that narrower eligibility in the tests.
